news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results before market open on August 7, 2026, followed by a management webcast conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: RPID Affiliate Files Form 144 for Proposed Sale of 10,000 Class A Shares
news.summary: A Rapid Micro Biosystems affiliate filed a routine Form 144 with the SEC on July 8, 2026, disclosing a proposed sale of 10,000 Class A common shares, a minor, non-operational insider transaction notice.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 60,000 restricted stock units of Class A common stock to a newly hired employee as a material inducement to employment, with the award vesting in three equal annual installments.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems will report second-quarter 2026 results before market open with an 8:30 a.m. ET webcast; investors will watch system placement pace, recurring/consumables revenue growth, and progress toward full-year guidance after Q1's revenue beat but wider-than-expected net loss.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue and placement guidance
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to $37M-$41M total revenue and 30-38 Growth Direct system placements for 2026 with roughly 20% gross margin (mid-20s% exit rate in Q4); Q2 results will show whether the company remains on track after six placements and an 11% revenue increase in Q1.

catalysts.label: Continued Growth Direct rollout with anchor accounts
catalysts.detail: Following recent multi-system expansion orders from Amgen and Samsung Biologics, further follow-on orders from existing large pharma and biologics customers remain a potential upside catalyst for placement volume.

catalysts.label: MilliporeSigma exclusive services deal and pending supply agreement
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems has an exclusive validation, qualification and maintenance services agreement with MilliporeSigma and, per Q1 2026 management commentary, is working toward a related supply agreement intended to support gross margin expansion.

pulse: RPID shares remain deeply out of favor in 2026, trading around $2 (near multi-year lows) after a dilutive ~$9.8M (up to ~$32M with warrants) financing from Bain Capital Life Sciences and Armistice Capital in May, with news flow since largely limited to routine corporate housekeeping (an inducement equity grant, a minor Form 144 insider sale notice) and confirmation of the Q2 earnings date. Operationally the story is one of steady but uneven progress: Q1 2026 revenue rose 11% to $8.0M on a record six Growth Direct placements and reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $37M-$41M, yet the net loss came in wider than expected, keeping investor focus on cash burn and further dilution risk. The next major catalyst is the Q2 2026 earnings report on August 7, 2026, which will test whether placement momentum, recurring-revenue growth, and the MilliporeSigma partnership are translating into progress toward full-year targets and margin expansion.
